description: This file defines a mock class for OpenCDMSession used in testing, utilizing Google Mock framework. It includes mock methods for session management, key handling, and protection metadata operations.

classes.name: OpenCDMSessionMock
classes.description: A mock class for OpenCDMSession used in unit testing, providing mock implementations for session management and key handling methods.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Mock method to initialize the session, with overloads for different parameter sets.

methods.name: generateRequest
methods.description: Mock method to generate a license request with specified data types and data buffers.

methods.name: loadSession
methods.description: Mock method to load an existing session.

methods.name: updateSession
methods.description: Mock method to update the session with license data.

methods.name: getChallengeData
methods.description: Mock method to retrieve challenge data for license acquisition.

methods.name: containsKey
methods.description: Mock method to check if a key ID is present in the session.

methods.name: setDrmHeader
methods.description: Mock method to set DRM header data.

methods.name: selectKeyId
methods.description: Mock method to select a specific key ID for the session.

methods.name: addProtectionMeta
methods.description: Overloaded mock methods to add protection metadata to buffers.

methods.name: closeSession
methods.description: Mock method to close the session.

methods.name: removeSession
methods.description: Mock method to remove the session.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Mock method to get the status of a key.

methods.name: getSessionId
methods.description: Mock method to retrieve the session ID.

methods.name: getLastDrmError
methods.description: Mock method to get the last DRM error code.
